queries_run: Amkor Technology export control OR entity list 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：Amkor 在中國、日韓、馬來西亞、菲律賓、葡萄牙、新加坡、台灣、越南設廠，客戶與供應商多在美國境外；公司稱美中關係與貿易政策變動、關稅、出口管制已對並可能持續對業務造成不利影響；BIS 規則限制先進運算晶片與設備出口中國，部分非美國競爭對手可能豁免。
findings.excerpt: Certain of the Company’s competitors may be exempt from the BIS Regulations by virtue of being non-U.S. manufacturers.

findings.claim: 10-K 稱 2025 年美國多次宣布關稅與出口管制變動，多數後來暫停或修訂；公司無法預測後續行動，關稅可能影響終端需求而不利於公司。
findings.excerpt: We cannot predict what further actions may ultimately be taken by the U.S. with respect to tariffs, export restrictions or other trade measures, what products or entities may be subject to such actions, or what actions may be taken by other countries in response to these U.S. actions.

findings.claim: MD&A：公司持續監控全球貿易政策，關稅影響取決於不確定的未來發展。
findings.excerpt: The degree to which such tariffs and other related actions impact our business, financial condition and results of operations will depend on future developments, which are uncertain.

findings.claim: 10-K 競爭段：地緣貿易緊張提高了支援中國在地供應鏈的中國同業競爭。
findings.excerpt: geopolitical trade tensions have increased competition from Chinese firms supporting a China-for-China supply chain.

reg_tariff_export.note: 搜尋未找到 Amkor 被列入 Entity List 或 Section 232 專屬衝擊的來源；搜尋摘要僅見 2026 10-Q 沿用監控貿易政策語句，未讀頁面故不列 finding。
